output.answer_markdown: The material does not support an FY2022 unadjusted EBITDA % margin for PepsiCo. The cash flow statement shows depreciation and amortization of 2,763 million for 2022 [1], but no unadjusted operating income figure from the P&L statement and no FY2022 net revenue figure is available, so neither EBITDA nor the margin can be calculated.

claims.text: Depreciation and amortization for 2022 is 2,763 million in the consolidated statement of cash flows.

found: Depreciation and amortization of 2,763 million for 2022 from the consolidated statement of cash flows
missing: FY2022 unadjusted operating income from the consolidated P&L statement
FY2022 net revenue to use as the margin denominator
